subject.title: Support Qwen Cloud personal token plan, and unblock Alibaba Token Plan on Linux

question: Should Qwen Cloud personal usage ship as a `qwen` region of the existing Alibaba Token Plan provider even though the current provider metadata cannot label its rolling windows accurately?
rationale: The implementation deliberately leaves a user-visible semantic mismatch because labels are static, so accepting the current shape versus requiring region-aware metadata is a product/UI contract choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Require accurate rolling-window labels
options.body: Add a region-aware presentation path so the Qwen personal plan is shown as 5-hour/session and weekly usage before merging.

options.title: Accept the current shared labels
options.body: Merge the Qwen region with the documented `Credits` and `Usage` labels, accepting the temporary terminology mismatch.

options.title: Defer the new region
options.body: Keep the Linux manual-cookie fix separate and postpone Qwen personal-plan support until the provider presentation model is settled.

recommendation.title: Require accurate rolling-window labels
recommendation.body: Add a region-aware presentation path so the Qwen personal plan is shown as 5-hour/session and weekly usage before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the best available routing candidate for the provider-surface and presentation decision.
